content:
Anya: Hey team, onboarding a new Llama-compat model via hf-importer failed during safetensors assembly.
Raz: what error?
Anya: convert-bot printed `IndexError: shard index 11 not found` and the safetensors index.json lists 12 entries but only 11 blobs in the blobstore.
convert-bot: deploy 2364: hf-importer: assemble_shards failed - index mismatch (expected 12, found 11) -- partial blob download due to 401/403 on blob 11
Jordan: that's the hub auth token rotation issue again? which retry/backoff did we hit?
Anya: logs show 403 on GET https://huggingface.co/repo/resolve/.../pytorch_model.safetensors/part-11 -> `AccessDenied` after 30s fetch; converter gave up and wrote incomplete index.
Mike: also saw model config.json missing `bos_token` and chat_template had escaped `\n` in system prompt which broke chatfmt parsing.
Raz: ugh. Did the key-rename step also run? We had a test where weight keys got prefixed with `model.` during renaming which breaks the quantizer mapping.
Anya: yes, after assemble we ran key_normalizer that renamed `layers.0.attn.k_proj.weight` -> `model.layers.0.attn.k_proj.weight`. Quantization mapping expected the old keys -> quantized checkpoint wrong shape.
Jordan: reproduction steps?
Anya: 
```
# quick repro
hf-importer --repo repo/name --rev main --out /tmp/import
# logs show:
ERROR: blob part-11 403
ERROR: index.json assembled(12 entries) but 11 blobs
```
Raz: workaround: 1) retry GET with longer backoff and 2) don't atomically write final index until all blobs verified. 3) key_normalizer should run before quantize_stage and should preserve original keys in a mapping file.
Mike: also the chat_template parser should unescape `\n` sequences before evaluating placeholders. Right now the template loader calls `json.loads()` and leaves `\n` as two chars not newline.
Jordan: quick patch proposals?
Anya: PRs: https://git/repo/pull/423 (add blob verification & atomic tempfile), https://git/repo/pull/424 (emit keymap.json and run normalizer earlier), https://git/repo/pull/425 (chat_template: raw_decode->replace('\\n','\n')).
Raz: can we add an integration test that simulates a 403 on one shard and ensures importer retries and doesn't produce a bad index?
Jordan: yes, test harness change tracked in #importer-ci.
convert-bot: note: rolling back the 2026-03-18 importer change in staging until fixes land :information_source:
Mike: thanks — I'll run a quick quant regression eval comparing q4_0 runs with and without the key rename mapping.
Anya: tagging @ops to whitelist the HF blob URLs for the temporary org token while we patch.
Raz: good plan. I'll take the blob verification PR.
Anya: thanks — will monitor.
